about: ASTs, call graphs, MCP, agent observability
local AI, Windows internals, GPU systems

intro.heading: I build the parts AI coding agents are still missing.
paragraphs: I am Anand B - Co-Founder at Arbor, computer science student at VIT Vellore, and a systems builder obsessed with making complex software legible.

My main bet is Arbor: graph-native code intelligence that maps a repository with ASTs, walks the real call paths behind a pull request, and gives humans and coding agents the exact blast radius before merge.
intro.quote: The same commit should produce the same answer. Deterministic context beats plausible guesswork.

projects.title: Arbor
projects.tagline: The map AI coding agents are missing.
projects.desc: A Rust graph engine, PR blast-radius system, and MCP context layer built around deterministic program understanding instead of embedding-based RAG.

projects.title: Bleurs
projects.tagline: Ground truth for APIs used by coding agents.
projects.desc: Blocks the APIs that do not exist and serves the ones that do - one index, queried in both directions.

projects.title: LoRA-JIT
projects.tagline: Structural weight paging for consumer GPUs.
projects.desc: Experiments in local adapter routing, just-in-time model state, and the telemetry needed to know when the system is actually winning.

projects.title: Legion + LOQ Control
projects.tagline: A safer, bloat-free Lenovo Vantage replacement.
projects.desc: A Windows-first control plane with read-only discovery, explicit capability evidence, and a short-lived elevated broker for guarded hardware access.
